added_failures_source: Derived from the reviewed run's own gate logs as the node requires. baseline_suite log (revision ca630c06e894d95111a8627b11d02a023aa270dd): 17 failing ids. after_suite log suite-at-head-attempt4.log (revision a08a2baae993a98d6b7172b403a103110bb1e012): 12 failing ids. Set difference head-minus-base = 8 ids, independently recomputed with reckon.crew.review.added_failures_from_gate_logs and by hand: the 5 added deterministic ids the fragment counts, plus 3 load-only ids absent from the baseline (producer_takes_new_code, landing_contract_and_gate_agree, crew_ephemeral_members). The two landing_write_races parametrisations are NOT added: they appear in the baseline's own failing set.

findings.text: follow-on: the three load-only head failures that are genuinely absent from the baseline (tests/test_producer_takes_new_code.py::test_the_follow_json_surface_carries_the_stale_producer, tests/test_landing_contract_and_gate_agree.py::test_every_default_role_agrees_with_the_promotion_gate, tests/test_crew_ephemeral_members.py::test_unnamed_dispatches_are_isolated_and_never_reuse_a_captured_session) receive no candidate-commit attribution and are excluded from the measure by its deterministic-only definition, so a picker or dispatch cause among them would leave the measure of 3 understating the picker-contact added failures.

item_verdicts.call_sites: no production call site can reach a static evidence fragment; the change is documentation only
item_verdicts.diff: read the diff a08a2baa..91cfcbe3 (one path): the new fragment records the whole-suite command, the 12 failing ids, the solo re-run table, the closing-head classification, the five added deterministic ids with candidates, and the measure; no product source or test file changed.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when's command, one logged run with its EXIT line, every failing id, the deterministic/load-only split and the baseline classification are all present in docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/suite-at-head.html; suite-at-head-attempt4.log ends EXIT=1 with the summary '12 failed, 10268 passed, 76 skipped, 59 warnings in 1740.83s' and solo-rerun.log holds 12 one-test processes reading 7 failed / 5 passed.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to measure the whole suite at head against the 2026-10-02 baseline, and docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/suite-at-head.html does exactly that: one whole-suite run at a08a2baae, every failing id, a solo re-run separating deterministic from load-only, a classification against suite-closing.json, a candidate commit per added deterministic id, and the measure 3.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 91cfcbe3c, baseline_suite revision ca630c06 with 17 failing ids and after_suite revision a08a2baae with 12, both completed with EXIT=1, and a per-id failure_attribution naming candidates.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the one commit 91cfcbe3c touches only the declared fragment path docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/suite-at-head.html (+135 lines); the granted figure path docs/figures/one-typesafe-model-picker/suite-at-head is unused and correctly so, because the done-when names no figure artifact.

justifications.durability: the node is documentation-only and adds no test, so no assertion fails if the fragment's numbers drift; its claims are nonetheless reproducible from persisted artifacts, and I independently recomputed the head/baseline failing sets and the added-failure set difference (8 ids) from the two gate logs, but nothing guards the fragment automatically.
justifications.evidence: suite-at-head-attempt4.log's own summary line reads '12 failed, 10268 passed, 76 skipped, 59 warnings in 1740.83s' and it ends 'EXIT=1' at revision a08a2baae with no ENOSPC, and the baseline record suite-closing.json at ca630c06 carries the 17 failing ids the manifest's baseline_suite names; the numbers are recorded in logs, not merely claimed.
justifications.fit: docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/suite-at-head.html follows the landed-report <article class="landed-report"> convention of the sibling fragments and names no plan label, sprint id or version suffix in its text or in the commit subject/body.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the fragment records the whole-suite run at a08a2baae with 12 failing ids, re-runs each alone (solo-rerun.log, 7 deterministic / 5 load-only), classifies the 7 deterministic against the closing-head set (suite-closing.json, 14 deterministic + 3 load-only) as 2 pre-existing / 5 added, and closes with the measure 3, which I reconciled against both gate logs.
justifications.scope_discipline: the single commit 91cfcbe3c adds exactly the declared fragment docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/suite-at-head.html (+135) and nothing else, and the granted figure path is unused because the done-when names no figure.
